## Checklist

- [ ] `npx eslint .`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] I wrote the test first (or the fix has a test that reproduces the bug)
- [ ] No new network requests, analytics, cookies, keys or environment variables
- [ ] Every URL was opened in a browser; legal items have a `verifiedOn` date and a primary source
- [ ] No real victim data anywhere; examples are fake
- [ ] Visible text uses hyphens only, no em or en dashes
- [ ] Images (if any) are public domain, CC0 or generated, recorded in `public/LICENSES.md`
